messages:
alex.g: Heads-up — planning to roll runtime v2.3.1 tonight in the 02:30 UTC window. Router header change needed (x-rdwd-route -> x-rdwd-route-v2). Can the router and console teams be on the same cadence? :eyes:
priya: @alex.g what's the canary slice? are we doing 5%->25% ramp?
sam: deploy-bot scheduled at 02:30, canary 5% for 10m then 25% for 10m if no errs. leaving the pin window at 03:30.
deploy-bot: Canary job created: job_id=cb-704321, slice=5%, duration=10m. Notifying infra and ops. Logs -> http://ci.internal/704321
linda.console: Console will need a header mapper change + release note. I'll patch docs and surface a banner during the surge window. Do we have a release note snippet?
alex.g: Snippet for release notes: "runtime: kernel/kv eviction improvements; router header updated to x-rdwd-route-v2 (backwards compatible)." Keep short.
priya: Important: if latency >10% in first canary window we rollback. Also monitor 95th p95 token-latency across routes.
sam: Agree. Add circuit-breaker on router B as fallback. Also we should pin API to v1.9 for traffic that needs old header mapping. How do we coordinate the pin?
alex.g: Plan: 1) start canary 5% 2) monitor p95 + error-rate 3) if spike -> pin traffic to api v1.9 and trigger rollback on runtime 4) if stable -> continue ramp.
ops-bot: Alert rule deployed: canary_latency_spike (p95 increase >12% over baseline for 3m) -> post in #incidents and notify @ops-sre.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics (first 6m): p95 +3.2%, err_rate +0.02%. No action yet.
sam: I'm seeing a spike on router-A in tail latency, ~18% at minute 7. Tagging @priya and @linda.console.
priya: that's over our 10% thresh. Recommend immediate traffic pin to api v1.9 and rollback runtime.
alex.g: Agreed. Run rollback and pin. Sam/infra, can you execute? I'll document in release notes that this is a rollback due to canary latency.
sam: Running rollback now. Command:```bash
./deployctl rollback --service runtime --to v2.3.0 --job cb-704321 --reason "canary-latency"
```
deploy-bot: Rollback started: rollback_id=rb-704321. Router traffic pinned to api v1.9. Canary aborted.
linda.console: Pushing console banner: "We rolled back runtime v2.3.1 due to canary latency. Investigating — services remain online." Updated release notes with rollback details.
priya: Filing an after-action ticket with traces: include request ids around spike, KV cache hit rates, and kernel config diff. I'll own the investigation.
alex.g: Thanks team. Post-mortem plan: small dry-run on a dev shard tomorrow 09:00 UTC, then reattempt with incremental kernel toggle and tighter monitoring. :thumbsup:
